Containers.Name: Unraid Markdown & HTML File Editor
Containers.Description: Edit and preview Markdown and HTML files directly from Shares > Browse.
Containers.Overview:
Unraid Markdown & HTML File Editor replaces the built-in text editor for Markdown and HTML files opened from Shares > Browse.
[b]Features:[/b] - CodeMirror source editor for .md, .markdown, .html, and .htm files. - Edit, split, and live-preview modes, including a distraction-free full-page mode. - Sandboxed HTML previews: scripts can run without access to the Unraid parent page. - CSRF validation, path allowlisting, and atomic saves. - Other file types continue to use the native Dynamix viewer and editor.
